title: Stop writing Athena trailers in commits after C0 (D111)
summary: When [history] cutover_job is set, new commits after C0 (intervention, records-only, landing, squash and pull-request commits) carry no Athena- trailers. Tests use the k0tt cutover fixture (test_support.rs) and cover a landing through land_pr, retry_landing after C0, and the status trace and auditor entry points. With no cutover_job, behavior is unchanged. The audience is the maintainer and the verifier, who run the tests.

defaults_applied.how: All changes and tests are Rust.
Each changed reader and writer has a test. cargo test and clippy pass.
Criteria exercise real entry points: land_pr, retry_landing, the status trace and the auditor.
An independent verifier runs the tests.
Trailer writing is gated at the commit writers, not patched per call site.
One focused change to the trailer writers and their readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job k0tt has landed, so test_support.rs and its CutoverFixture exist. I confirmed they are in the repository.
Decision D111 defines C0 as the host commit of the cutover job's landing record. Whether a commit is post-C0 is read from the config at the relevant commit.
The athena-git helpers that strip lines (squash_text_relaxed) may need a change, as the earlier emm8 attempt showed.
The fixture's fake host squash message has no '(#n)' suffix. Tests must account for that.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test on the cutover fixture lands a new job branch (intervention commit, records-only commit, job landing) through land_pr with a squash merge. The squash commit on main and the three pull-request commits reached from the records branch have no Athena- lines. The landing record classifies them. check --history and check --attribution report no violations. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
A test covers retry_landing for a blocked job after C0: no trailer search, no 'closing commit not found' bail, and no Athena-Verified-Content written. Run: cargo test -p athena-core retry_landing.
Tests call athena status's trace and the auditor through their real entry points on a post-C0 job and get correct results. Run: cargo test.
With no cutover_job configured, trailers are written as before. All existing tests pass, cargo clippy is clean and cargo fmt --check passes. Run: cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and docs/decisions.md records the D111 trailer-stop design, the alternatives and the retry_landing post-C0 behavior. It removes the stale 'retry_landing has no test' statement.
The fixture is the k0tt helper, with a job landed the old way through the real writers. No hand-built records are substituted.

out_of_scope: Rewriting history or changing pre-C0 commits.
departures: The request is large and was rejected once, because its fixture was unrealistic and retry_landing had no test. I raised cost and lowered the pass probability.
